profile.headline: Software Engineer at L3Harris Technologies | Web Development

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Palm Bay, Florida, United States · On-site

positions.title: Software Developer Internship
positions.description:
- Developed and migrated automated tests from an existing project using Enzyme onto React Testing Library and Cypress.

- Conducted and presented research on different React testing frameworks and the benefits and drawbacks of each one.

- Participated in weekly in-person developer meetings hosted by subject matter experts discussing React best practices and technology.

positions.title: Software Developer Internship
positions.description:
-	Developed and designed a web app using HTML, CSS, and Bootstrap utilizing the agile developing process.
-	Participated in weekly virtual developer meetings hosted by subject matter experts discussing project performance and outlook through Microsoft Teams.
-	Updated and pushed project iterations using GitHub and Git Bash.

honors.title: Finalist in UCF Knight Hacks Hackathon 2021
honors.description:
• Placed 2nd place in beginner track.
• 2-day event with over 160 participants.
• Created a web application with React.js utilizing Google maps and places API to 
locate and share food truck locations.
honors.issuer: Issued by UCF Knight Hacks · Nov 2021
